display_name: Synology DSM + Active Backup for Business
description: Every client NAS's Active Backup jobs and storage health, mirrored into one local SQLite database and checked with one command.

auth_env_var_specs.name: SYNOLOGY_ACCOUNT
auth_env_var_specs.description: DSM account name used for the SYNO.API.Auth login

auth_env_var_specs.name: SYNOLOGY_PASSWORD
auth_env_var_specs.description: DSM account password; sent in the login request body, never stored by the CLI

auth_env_var_specs.name: SYNOLOGY_DEVICE_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: Trusted-device token (did) from a previous two-factor login, used instead of a one-time code

auth_env_var_specs.name: SYNOLOGY_OTP_CODE
auth_env_var_specs.description: Six-digit one-time code for the first login of a two-factor account

auth_description: A DSM account on the NAS (an administrator, or an account granted the Active Backup for Business application). Two-factor accounts use a trusted-device token.

novel_features.name: Fleet status rollup
novel_features.description: One row per client NAS with backup outcomes, stale devices, worst storage state and sync age; exits 6 when any NAS is warning, critical or unknown (--no-fail exits 0).

novel_features.name: ABB failures
novel_features.description: Every Active Backup task across the fleet whose latest run in a window failed, partially succeeded, was canceled, or never ran.

novel_features.name: Stale protection
novel_features.description: Protected PCs, servers and VMs whose last successful backup is older than a threshold, or that never succeeded.

novel_features.name: Per-NAS fleet sync
novel_features.description: Mirror ABB job status and storage health from every NAS registered with fleet add into one local database, each NAS with its own login.

novel_features.name: Fleet storage health
novel_features.description: Degraded or crashed volumes and pools, disks with bad SMART status, hot disks and nearly full volumes across every NAS, with days-to-full when history exists.

novel_features.name: Failed-task triage
novel_features.description: Why one ABB task failed: its newest non-success run, its detail lines and the ABB log from that window, errors first. Live call to one NAS; DSM returns log types and parameters, not message text.

novel_features.name: Device lookup
novel_features.description: Find a machine by host name across every NAS and see which task protects it, its last success and its recent runs.

novel_features.name: Backup trend
novel_features.description: Per task or device: run count, success rate, median and p90 duration, and an overrun flag when the latest run is far slower than usual.

novel_features.name: Protection dropped
novel_features.description: Devices and tasks that dropped out of Active Backup protection across the fleet: a machine removed from its task, a task deleted, or a task whose schedule is off while it still holds devices; exits 6 when any exist or a NAS mirror is not synced or ABB stopped answering (--no-fail exits 0).

novel_features.name: Volume runway
novel_features.description: Every volume on every NAS with used percent, growth per day and days until full from retained storage snapshots, soonest first; exits 6 when a volume fills inside the horizon (default 30 days), a volume's capacity is unknown, or a NAS's storage cannot be read (--no-fail exits 0).

novel_features.name: Change-rate anomaly
novel_features.description: Devices whose newest good backup moved far more data than their own median (a mass file change) or nothing at all for several runs in a row, across the fleet; exits 6 when any device is flagged or a NAS mirror is not synced or ABB stopped answering (--no-fail exits 0).
